channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Outside capital headlined the period: Abertis' Metropistas plans about $389M more in toll-road investment, Global Ports Holding is advancing a $200M+ San Juan cruise port program, and Marriott, Dunkin' (Inspire Brands) and Planet Fitness are entering or expanding. Federal money kept landing, including FEMA approvals above $45M, an $8M NSF stem-cell center at UPR Mayagüez, a $19.9M NIH biomedical grant and a new DARPA cyber-defense pilot. The main risks are energy: record residential rates, a federal court order forcing New Fortress Energy to open its LNG terminal amid fuel shortages, and restaurants and manufacturers warning on costs. The Fiscal Board's pushback on the proposed sales-tax suspension also continues to frame fiscal-climate questions for investors.
